import parse

# Test R9 behavior - left/center alignment consuming up to next space
tests = [
    # (pattern, string, expected_search_result)
    ('{:<}', 'hello   world', 'hello'),  # Left align should stop at space
    ('{:^}', ' hello ', 'hello'),  # Center align should trim whitespace  
    ('{:>}', 'hello   world', 'hello'),  # Right align - current behavior?
    ('{:<}', 'hello', 'hello'),  # No trailing space
]

for pattern, string, expected in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    r = p.search(string)
    result = r[0] if r else None
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} search({pattern!r}, {string!r}): got {result!r}, expected {expected!r}")
    print(f"   expr={p._expression!r}")
PYEOF
